proposal.title: Cedar of Lebanon Canopy
proposal.idea: A sun-dappled forest canopy, with a slow, rhythmic, and textural glow, that evokes quiet reverence.
proposal.geometry: Layered, concentric circles that grow progressively smaller from a central point, mirroring the tiers of the cedar boughs.
proposal.typography: Noto Serif for the scripture, a sans serif for the lyric, with a simple, legible scale.
proposal.imageLogic: A continuous procedural scene with soft, dappled light and shimmering particles, gradually modulated by the audio.
proposal.texture: A textured, yet still, material weave that evokes a sense of depth and realism, achieved with procedural shaders.
proposal.motion: Soft, fluid movement of light and particles, responding to the audio cues, with a subtle emphasis on growth and glow.
proposal.productionMethod: Generative, procedural visual scene rendered with a focus on layering and texture to create the desired mood.
proposal.humanTrace: Simulated, textured, organic materials mimicking wood grain, with subtle light leaks and anamorphic flare mimicking real-world film stock.
proposal.risk: The risk is that the visual could feel too abstract or overly generic, leading to a lack of specificity and emotional connection.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist may overemphasize a dramatic effect with a focus on color and light, potentially losing the subtle, textured aesthetic.
